main.remarks: Denies policy evaluation when the supplied protected operation is not authorized by the validated membership.

method.name: Evaluate
method.summary: Evaluate whether the supplied protected operation is authorized by the policy context.
method.returns: Deny when the protected operation is not allowed; otherwise allow.

method.name: EvaluateAsync
method.summary: Evaluate asynchronously whether the supplied protected operation is authorized by the policy context.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous stage evaluation.
method.returns: Deny when the protected operation is not allowed; otherwise allow.
